init_hook: root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" && [ "$(cd "$root" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P)" = "$(pwd -P)" ] && git config core.hooksPath .githooks >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

[ "$(rustup component list --installed --toolchain "$RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN" 2>/dev/null | grep -c -E '^(rustfmt-|clippy-|rust-std-wasm32-wasip1$)')" = 3 ] || rustup toolchain install "$RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN" --profile minimal --component rustfmt,clippy --target wasm32-wasip1 || echo "Rust $RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN is not completely installed: see the error above. Everything else here works, but Rust actions may not build, format or lint until a later start completes it." >&2
